environment_canvas (applies to every shot of this clip and is held identical across all clips):
East Asian fantasy concept painting, a Zen immortal Taoist sanctuary. A fully timber ancient East Asian corridor spans the entire frame: thick dark-brown wooden columns and beams with weathered grain and aged patina, a dark tiled roof, hard horizontal geometric lines. At the centre of the corridor a huge square courtyard opening frames a towering ancient pine - deep brown gnarled trunk, contorted branches, a dense deep blue-green canopy that nearly fills the opening; the hard timber geometry contrasts strongly with the pine's irregular organic form. A few tiny white-robed figures in white lean on the narrow railing platform as scale reference. The whole structure floats above a boundless sea of clouds, no ground visible: layered soft grey-blue cloud churns toward an endless horizon, faint floating island silhouettes emerging in the far cloud sea. The sky is a uniform grey-blue, calm, low-saturation, almost cloudless, leaving a large restrained cool-toned background. Lighting: warm side light rakes the eave edges, the lit faces of the columns and the pine trunk, forming warm gold rim accents and volume; most of the frame stays in cool shadow; sparse bright specular highlights sit on eave corners, leaf tips and cloud tops. Roughly 85 percent cool tone, 10 to 15 percent warm tone concentrated precisely on the lit edges; restrained, refined cool-warm contrast. Camera language: eye-level medium-long shot at the height of the corridor platform, horizontal composition emphasising the corridor's extension, the central pine carrying the vertical height, foreground corridor columns forming a frame that leads the eye to the courtyard pine and the distant cloud sea, the white-robed figures balanced left and right. Style: traditional East Asian painting texture, Song-dynasty landscape meeting contemporary concept art; fine brushwork but not photorealistic, flat colour blocks combined with gradients, edges crisp yet breathing, cloud layers soft and stratified like colour-on-silk album leaves, timber and pine rendered with weight and condensation, the whole frame a carefully tuned, colour-card-like high-grade grey palette, solemn as an Oriental fantasy scroll. Palette: sky and atmosphere grey-blue #3D6683, cloud sea and mist #7594A6, canopy and shadow #273E48, timber #774332, warm light edges #C2673A, specular highlights #D8D4C0.

detailed_description:
[Shot 3] CLOSE-UP, head-and-shoulders framing; her face fills the frame and every feature is rendered with fine detail - eyes, brows, lips, nose, skin texture and stray hairs. Continuing from the previous final frames, the corridor opens onto a broad timber stair rising through hanging cloud, the giant pine and the layered cloud sea hanging far behind her as a heavily defocused backdrop. The camera stops pulling back and holds close on her face, drifting only slightly as she climbs. S1 sings on the vocal line with exact lip sync while stepping upward, ribbons trailing behind her and catching the updraft, her expression calm, open and unhurried. End with her still ascending, motion continuous, for the next clip to continue.

overall_soundscape:
Footfalls on stone, rising wind, faint chimes, and her breathing under the song.

non_diegetic_music:
The master song drives the singing, breathing, body rhythm, and emotional timing.

subject_definitions:
<人物1> 由<参考图1>定义面部身份、<参考图2>定义全身外形共同确定的同一人物；包含汉服服饰、身体比例以及各类辨识度细节。

summary:
[参考图生成] 生成一镜到底连续镜头：歌者，一边行走一边吟唱，走入云雾缭绕的仙宫；镜头改为远景全身构图，人物完整从头到脚入画，同时保留面部与表演动作的可辨识度。

retention_analysis:
<人物1>（全程出现在【镜头1】）：完全保留——保留面部特征、发型特征、身体比例、汉服形制、广袖与飘带细节、色彩，以及参考图里全部标志性特征；人物表情、姿态、光照、取景画幅、动作跟随表演动态变化。面部渲染要求：锐利清晰的高频细节，眉眼轮廓分明、唇线干净利落，细腻皮肤纹理，还原真实毛孔与细碎发丝；禁止模糊、涂抹糊化、塑胶感磨皮、蜡像质感皮肤。即使在远景全身构图中，人物面部仍需保持可识别、清晰对焦，避免因距离过大导致五官糊化。

environment_canvas（适用于本片段全部镜头，所有片段环境保持完全一致）：
东亚幻想概念绘画，道家风韵的仙家秘境。整幅画面横贯一条完整的东亚古木回廊：粗壮深褐色木柱木梁，带着风化木纹与岁月包浆，深色瓦片屋顶，硬朗规整的水平几何线条。回廊中央方形天井，框住一棵参天古松：深褐色虬曲树干、盘错枝干，浓密的蓝绿色树冠几乎填满天井；坚硬木结构几何轮廓，与松树肆意舒展的有机形态形成强烈对比。栏杆平台上有几个渺小白衣人物倚靠，用作画面比例参照。整座建筑漂浮于无边云海之上，无地面可见：层层叠叠灰蓝色云雾翻涌，延展至无尽天际，云海远方隐约浮现浮岛轮廓。天空统一为灰蓝色，色调沉静低饱和，近乎无云，构成克制的冷调大背景。
光照：暖调侧光扫过屋檐边缘、木柱受光面与松树干，勾勒出暖金色轮廓光，塑造物体体积；画面大部分区域处于冷调阴影；屋檐尖角、叶尖、云海顶端点缀少量明亮高光。画面约85%为冷色调，10‑15%暖色调仅集中在受光轮廓边缘；克制高级的冷暖对比。
镜头语言：与回廊平台齐眼高度的远景全身镜头，横向构图突出回廊纵深感；居中松树承担画面纵向高度；前景木柱形成画框，引导视线落向天井古松与远方云海；白衣小人物在画面左右两侧均衡分布。

美术风格：东亚传统绘画质感，宋代山水结合现代概念美术；笔触精致但非写实照片风；平涂色块叠加渐变，轮廓利落又富有气韵；云层层次柔和，如同绢本册页设色；木材与松树绘制厚重有质感；整体是调试考究、色卡级高级灰配色，氛围肃穆，如同东方幻想古卷。
色值参考：天空氛围灰蓝 #3D6683，云海雾霭 #7594A6，树冠暗部 #273E48，木构件 #774332，暖光轮廓 #C2673A，高光 #D8D4C0。

detailed_description:
【镜头1】远景全身镜头，人物完整从头到脚入画，身体高度约占画面纵向比例的二分之一到三分之二，面部与上半身仍是画面中清晰度最高的区域。镜头起始位置：悬浮仙宫外门，饱经风霜的深褐色长木回廊从缓缓翻涌的云海中延伸而出；中央方形天井框住参天古松，人物身后远处层叠飞檐屋顶做轻微虚化处理。相机保持稳定远景距离，与人物胸口等高向后平滑滑动，跟随向镜头走来的人物。
<人物1>(S1)一边行走一边歌唱，嘴部、下颌动作清晰可见，唇部动作严格对齐原唱歌曲的演唱节奏；广袖与浅色长飘带顺着云气轻轻飘动，裙摆和衣裾随步伐自然摆动。柔和淡金色逆光勾勒人物轮廓，面部保持均匀正面布光，必须清晰对焦。镜头结束于人物迈步中途，飘带、裙摆、云雾仍处于动态，保证下一段素材可以无缝承接本镜头动作。

overall_soundscape:
石间柔风，微弱丝绸摩擦声，歌声之下铺垫悠远空灵编钟音效。

non_diegetic_music:
主歌曲驱动演唱、呼吸、肢体节奏以及情绪时间线。
